goal: Allow CLI options to be placed after commands without being silently ignored or misparsed
Prevents confusing errors or targeting the wrong wallet when passing options after an RPC command
reviewability: Ready to review because the author addressed previous feedback on edge cases and CI passes
agreement: Strong support across the approach with edge cases tested and addressed
Full support after suggesting edge-case fixes that the author incorporated (w0xlt)
Verified tool consistency after concerns about bitcoin-tx behavior were resolved (vicjuma)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because options like -rpcwallet placed after a command no longer fall back to default
Eliminates silent wallet fallback and confusing parameter mismatch errors for CLI users

categories.name: tools
why: P3 because it brings consistent option handling after positional arguments to offline tools
Improves usability for tools like bitcoin-tx and bitcoin-wallet when passing trailing options

categories.name: utils
why: P3 because it fixes parser behavior where trailing options were silently swallowed as values
Unrecognized trailing options are now properly caught and validated across consumers
